name: CPU
source: AMD Q2, Intel Q1, Arm Q4 FY2026 + Microsoft Q3 FY2026, Dell Q1 FY2027
note: Datacenter CPU TAM expansion and the agentic-AI driven CPU:GPU ratio shift; x86 -> custom Arm migration.

tables.title: Server / datacenter CPU TAM
rows: ~$220bn by 2030 (>50% CAGR) — agentic-AI sandbox servers the largest & fastest-growing bucket; AMD server rev +>80% H2-26, +>70% FY27

tables.title: CPU:GPU ratio shift (agentic AI)
rows: 'almost in PARITY at this point and could eventually even skew MORE to CPUs on a unit basis'
CPU runs the harness — IO, branch, retries, state; 'in the loop in every decision an agent makes'

tables.title: Custom Arm CPU adoption (x86 -> Arm)
rows: Graviton — 98% of top-1,000 EC2 customers; Graviton5 ramping ~2x faster than G4; post-training RL + agent tool use run on CPUs ('strongest CPU chip, 30-40% better price-perf')
Cobalt live in ~50% of DC regions (Databricks, Siemens, Snowflake at scale); supply expanding significantly
Large liquid-cooled GPU racks (GB200/B300, Vera) biased to Arm; enterprise B200/B300/RTX systems x86

tables.title: CPU roadmaps
rows: Turin (Zen5) -> Venice (Zen6, 2nm) IN PRODUCTION NOW: >2x perf/W vs x86, 3.3x vs Arm, 30+ SKUs, cloud deploys late 2026 -> Verona with MI500 platform in 2027
Xeon 6 (Intel 3) -> Xeon 6+ (first server product on 18A, launched Q2 2026) -> Diamond Rapids -> Coral Rapids (adds SMT)
AGI CPU 136 cores; demand >$2bn FY27-28 (2x since launch), tracking to $15bn; first revenue Q4 FY27; head nodes at OpenAI/Cerebras/Rebellions/Positron
